card.name: "TO" in cephalosporin allergy warning
card.fires_on: The capitalized word "TO" in the all-caps warning about previous hypersensitivity reactions, right before a cephalosporin drug name. Weaker hits fall on word endings in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: All-caps allergy warning
modes.description: The word TO after HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS, just before a list of cephalosporin names.
modes.example: CAREFUL INQUIRY SHOULD BE MADE TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE PATIENT HAS HAD PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS<< TO>> CEFOXITIN, CEPHAL

modes.label: Ends of drug-interaction terms
modes.description: The last piece of a drug or pharmacology term, such as the end of Warfarin, a MAOI abbreviation, or the word bound.
modes.example: Most (98%) of plasma doxazosin is protein<< bound>>. In vitro data in human plasma indicate

card.plain: It marks the word TO in the capitalized warning about prior allergic reactions to cephalosporin antibiotics.
